title: Paul Prodigy - Ho Chorus
htmlContent:
Independent rap artist Paul Prodigy releases a new track titled "Ho Chorus". Paul Prodigy is a master of truly connecting with the listener and this song is a shining example of that, as he has that special thing that not only makes you a fan of the music, but a fan of his the person.

These songs are written in such a way that the listener will be able to enjoy to the music when they hear them. This is exemplified by the song “Ho Chorus.”
